notes: Questions are grounded in benchmark-v1.json and discussion-labels-v1.json. Those files are not modified. A verified_partial metadata source is the snapshot that carries the fact. It is not a complete audit of every document that might also mention the fact. Unverified paraphrases are not scored. realCorpus stays not_run.

unsupportedCategories.reason: The frozen import and discussion fetch stored issue and pull-request snapshots plus issue comments. No commit or file source ids are in the benchmark or the adjudicated labels.
No linked-issue edge was imported. The fixture suite already lists this as unsupported.
Issue bodies were not stored. Questions in this suite ask for a body only as verified-empty abstentions.
The bounded review fetch stored zero review rows. Review questions are verified-empty abstentions, not evidence that GitHub has no reviews.
